thread:
alyssa: FYI CI flake on go-sdk PR #142 — integration test hangs on retry backoff. looks different from ruby sdk behavior. anyone seen this?

dev-bot: CI: go-sdk-pr-142 failed -> https://ci.build/12345 · timeout in TestClientRetries (step=integration)

matt: can you paste the failing log + a minimal repro? curious if it's timeouts or the exponential backoff calc.

alyssa: log excerpt: "sleep duration too long: 10s" even though RetryMaxAttempts=3. repro runs locally for me. pasted minimal config below.

alyssa: ```go
client := NewClient(ClientOpts{
  RetryMaxAttempts: 3,
  RetryBaseDelay:  100 * time.Millisecond,
  RetryMultiplier: 2.0,
})
```

chris: hmm, I think go-sdk uses math.Pow to compute multiplier which does float -> rounding when converted to time.Duration; ruby uses integer multiplications so values differ slightly. that can push CI over the test timeout. quick fix: use integer multiply loop or cap the delay.

chris: example patch: ```go
delay := baseDelay
for i := 1; i < attempt; i++ {
  delay = delay * multiplierInt // avoid float math drift
}
time.Sleep(delay)
```

sam: if we change semantics, add a unit test that asserts deterministic backoff sequence and mention it in CHANGELOG. also update docs for default backoff values.

alyssa: added unit test to the PR and a small cap (maxDelay=2s) — still seeing CI fail on integration step but unit tests pass locally. @matt @chris can you review?

matt: will review tonight. for CI, we should mark the integration as flaky and re-run until infra stabilizes :shrug: also agree on capping max delay.

merge-bot: merge-queue: PR #142 added to canary, waiting for staging green.

alyssa: :thumbsup: thanks. i'll open an issue to align retry/backoff parity across SDKs and call out the cap + test as the short-term fix.
